name: ValueLlama-3-8B
notes: 8B-parameter English scorer fine-tuned using ValueBench and ValuePrism. Generates labels for two tasks: binary relevance and three-way valence (supports, opposes, or neutral/context-dependent) toward any supplied value.

name: UniVaR lambda-1
notes: 137M-parameter encoder trained from value-eliciting QA sets produced by eight source LLMs. Returns a dense representation without named value coordinates; the paper evaluates 15 models across 25 languages/cultures.

name: MoralBERT
notes: Ten separately trained binary classifiers cover the virtue and vice poles of five original Moral Foundations. The repository supports Liberty/Oppression, but those weights are not released.

developer: University of Washington / Allen Institute for AI
name: Kaleido
notes: Five released sizes (small, base, large, XL, XXL) trained from 218k ValuePrism records. Generates and explains values, rights, and duties and predicts binary relevance plus three-way valence.

name: FULCRA / BaseAlign
notes: Pipeline trained on 20,000 output-vector pairs. Produces a 10-dimensional Schwartz profile and 58 item-level priorities for generated text.

base_model: large concept extractor plus fine-tuned small evaluator
name: CLAVE
notes: Two-model evaluator calibrated with fewer than 100 human-labeled samples per value type; evaluated on more than 13,000 tuples across three value systems and more than 12 evaluators.
